display_long_description:
The Ultimate Street Racing Experience in Virtual Reality!

Step into an immersive 3D world and rediscover the classic thrill of arcade racing like never before. VR Street Racer - No Limits brings the legendary speed and adrenaline of street racing into a stunning low-poly virtual setting, where every drift feels impactful and every finish line is a step toward mastery.

Take control of your vehicle with precise steering using your controllers in a fully detailed cockpit. Watch as you navigate a stylized universe, dodging obstacles and triggering satisfying speed boosts. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing cruise or a high-stakes competitive challenge, this game offers endless tracks to test your driving skills.

Game Features:

Classic Racing Gameplay, Reimagined for VR: Enjoy familiar high-speed mechanics with the added depth and immersion of a virtual reality environment.

Intuitive Controller Interactions: Steer and accelerate with precision using your VR controllers for a natural and engaging driving experience.

Stunning Low-Poly Environments: Race through vibrant cityscapes and industrial shipping ports, creating a truly captivating and high-performance atmosphere.

Endless Strategic Tracks: Master the angles and physics of every turn to shave seconds off your time and earn higher scores.

Immersive Cockpit View: Feel the speed from the driver’s seat with real-time dashboards and realistic spatial awareness.
